prefix: Ilija Lupulesku (; born October 30, 19
text:
76) is an American professional football offensive lineman for the Seattle Seahawks and San Francisco 49ers.

Career
Lupulesku played college football for the University of California, Berkeley, the University of Colorado, and University of Utah, and earned an X Series in the 2007–08 season.

He was the Redman-Lupschi's player of the year in 2010–11 and was named to the First-team All-American in 2012.

On October 26, 2016, he was awarded a STEM diploma.

On October 27, 2017, he was named as an All-America in the S&P 500.

On October 28, 2018, he was named as the 2018-19 varsity athlete of the Year in Nevada.

Personal life
In 2016, Lupulesku married Lindsey Fronk, who is a stay-at-home teacher. In 2018, he was named as the Minnesota state athlete of the year.

It has been in the permanent state of south-west Australia since 1974.

The main natural features of the area are the Murray–State Highway (MSRH), the River Richards, the late 20th century railway tracks, the southern boundary of the country's fourth-largest river system, the river valley, which comprises the foothills of Murray State Road 263, and the village of Harap in the Upper Suburbs of Adelaide, South Australia.
